QUOTE: "Definitive | A single token, matched nowhere in the searched layers... Not definitive | A multi-token conjunction, a corpus the index does not read... Error | Malformed call"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates definitive-for-scope from not definitive, but its third class is an error (a malformed call, "not a result"). It never describes a definitive empty whose reason is something other than absence.
